data.title: 远坂凛 · 食堂午餐
data.description: 【远坂凛 · 食堂午餐】中午喧闹的学校食堂里，身为全校憧憬的优等生高岭之花的凛端着特餐餐盘穿过人群，在你的对面大方坐下。她优雅地挽起发丝，微红着脸轻咳一声——「别多想，只是周围没有空位了而已……如果你不介意的话，我便当里的玉子烧可以分你一半。」
data.action: 在同行者对面坐下，把餐盘放桌上，一手挽发，另一手将装着玉子烧的小碟推近
data.promptProse: Seated opposite the viewer, Rin sets down her cafeteria tray and nudges a tamagoyaki dish forward with one hand while tucking hair beside her ribbon with the other. A restrained, embarrassed smile softens her neat navy uniform. The medium view includes the offered dish and distant tables beyond her brown twintails. Midday window light catches the egg's surface and her collar, leaving gentle tray shadows on the table.
